instruction: Change the font size of the document title to 18 points

command: import pyautogui; import time; pyautogui.hotkey('ctrl', 's'); time.sleep(0.5);

metadata.explanation: Task requires changing the font size of the document title (first paragraph 'Libre Office: Open Source Word Processing') to exactly 18 points. The evaluator checks if the font size matches the expected 18pt with a small tolerance of 0.5pt to account for rounding. Custom getter extracts the font size from the first run with text in the first paragraph, custom metric verifies the size matches within tolerance.
